AUSTRALIAN VINTAGES
The Australian wine industry is one of the most advanced in the world. The first vines were
planted in Sydney in 1788, and today, the wines of Australia are internationally recognised and
Each Australian state has premium wine growing regions,
South Australia's Coonawarra, Clare and Barossa;
Victoria's Yarra Valley and Mornington Peninsula;
Margaret River in Western Australia,
and the Hunter Valley in New South Wales.
From these and other Australian regions we offer you a selection of the following wines:
RIESLING
Characterised by a highly aromatic, flowery nose, a tangy freshness on the palate with a crisp, clean,
refreshing finish.
CHARDONNAY
A very full and complex wine, with fresh fruity flavour ranging from green stone fruit to ripe
tropical fruit.
